## COPE-BP Clustering Feasibility

This R Markdown document compiles the process cluster pharmacies for the feasibility phase. It is based on the agreements of the annual meeting and further analysis within the WP1 and WP2 teams.

This document is automatically generated using the option **Knit** within an R-Markdown file. Therefore some content might not display correctly. Please contact the [Diego Pajarito Grajales](mailto:Diego.PajaritoGrajales@glasgow.ac.uk) for any additional requirement.

### Initial setup

The workflow uses different libraries such as **haven** and **readxl** for data management as well as [sf](https://r-spatial.github.io/sf/), **dplyr** and [leaflet](https://leafletjs.com) for geospatial data management.

```{r packages, include=FALSE}
# This is only needed once and in environments where the packages are not available
#install.packages("haven") # Required to process data files
#install.packages("readxl") # Required to process excell file
#install.packages("leaflet.extras")
```

```{r libraries, include=FALSE}
library(haven)
library(readxl)
library(readr)
library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(leaflet.extras)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)

# Libraries used to set up clusters
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
```


The datasets used are the survey data, transformed into geospatial datasets, and the distance matrices estimated for every city.


```{r read_survey_data, include=FALSE}
pk_data <- read_dta("Survey-v2/02_PCS/03_database/04_cleandata/COPE-BP_PK_PCQ.dta")

# For Bangladesh, at the moment, geospatial data is not integrated due to some missing values for location
bd_data <- read_dta("Survey-v2/02_PCS/03_database/04_cleandata/COPE-BP_BD_PCQ.dta")
bd_data_geo <- read_excel("Survey-v2/02_PCS/03_database/01_preload/pk_pharmacy_list.xlsx", sheet="Bangladesh Pharmacy Data")
```



```{r set_geometry_to_survey, include=FALSE}
# First we need to add geometries to the data set. We use the values in coordinates stored as columns.
# This uses a full join to only treat the data with known location

pk_data_geo <- pk_data %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("_location_longitude", "_location_latitude"), 
           crs = 4326,
           remove = FALSE)  # Keeps original columns

bd_data_geo <- merge(bd_data, bd_data_geo, by.x = "_id", by.y = "_id")

bd_data_geo <- bd_data_geo %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("_location_longitude", "_location_latitude"), 
           crs = 4326,
           remove = FALSE)  # Keeps original columns


```



```{r read_distance_matrix, include=FALSE}
# Bangladesh
bd_dhaka_distances <- read_csv("cluster-analysis/bd-dhaka-distance-matrix-pharmacies.csv")
bd_narsingdi_distances <- read_csv("cluster-analysis/bd-narsingdi-distance-matrix-pharmacies.csv")

# Pakistan
pk_abbottabad_distances <- read_csv("cluster-analysis/pk-abbottabad-distance-matrix-pharmacies.csv")
pk_peshawar_distances <- read_csv("cluster-analysis/pk-peshawar-distance-matrix-pharmacies.csv")

```

### Clustering 

To process the clusters, the team has decided to apply the following criteria:

- Each city will have 9 clusters. 
- Pharmacies will be clustered based on their geographic distribution.
- The method selected is K-means
- Consideration of pharmacies close to hospitals is omitted due difficulties such as:
  a) Pharmacies-to-hospital proximity usually smaller than 1km.
  b) Hospitals driving patients or pharmacy customers are not clearly defined. 
- Allow for identification of pharmacies reporting female staff members

Once the clusters are estimated, there will be a description that includes:
- pharmacy count
- count of pharmacies reporting female staff members
- average distance to the nearest hospital
- added footfall for all the pharmacies in the cluster (arithmetic addition)
- distance to the closest cluster




```{r variables_to_include, include=FALSE}
  
# Initial selection of variables to include
pk_data_geo <- pk_data_geo %>% select("_id", "pq_city", "pq_ward", ends_with("sex"), "pq_c_daily_cus", "geometry") 
bd_data_geo <- bd_data_geo %>% filter(pq_consent ==1) %>% # for Bangladesh there's need to filter eligible pharmacies only
  select("_id", "pq_city", "pq_ward", ends_with("sex"), "pq_c_daily_cus", "geometry")


# There are some estimates to derive the male/female staff reported
pk_data_geo <- pk_data_geo %>% 
  mutate(count_female = rowSums(across(ends_with("sex")) == 2, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  mutate(count_male = rowSums(across(ends_with("sex")) == 1, na.rm = TRUE))
bd_data_geo <- bd_data_geo %>% 
  mutate(count_female = rowSums(across(ends_with("sex")) == 2, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
  mutate(count_male = rowSums(across(ends_with("sex")) == 1, na.rm = TRUE))

# Variables carried out
pk_data_geo <- pk_data_geo %>% select("_id", "pq_city", "pq_ward", "count_female", "count_male", "pq_c_daily_cus", "geometry")
bd_data_geo <- bd_data_geo %>% select("_id", "pq_city", "pq_ward", "count_female", "count_male", "pq_c_daily_cus", "geometry")


```


```{r set_crs, include=FALSE}

# CRS is set; if missing, data comes in WGS84. Later data is projecte do local UTM
if (is.na(sf::st_crs(pk_data_geo))) {
  warning("CRS missing; assuming WGS84 (EPSG:4326). Adjust if different.")
  sf::st_crs(pk_data_geo) <- 4326
}
if (is.na(sf::st_crs(bd_data_geo))) {
  warning("CRS missing; assuming WGS84 (EPSG:4326). Adjust if different.")
  sf::st_crs(bd_data_geo) <- 4326
}

pk_data_utm <- sf::st_transform(pk_data_geo, 32642)
bd_data_utm <- sf::st_transform(bd_data_geo, 32642)

```

```{r prepare_city_subsets, include=FALSE}

# Prepare individual data sets per city
# 1, Dhaka North City Corporation (DNCC) | 2, Dhaka South City Corporation (DSCC) | 3, Narsingdi Paurashava | 4, Ghorashal Paurashava
bd_dhaka_data <- bd_data_utm[bd_data_utm$pq_city == 1 | bd_data_utm$pq_city == 2, ]
bd_narsi_data <- bd_data_utm[bd_data_utm$pq_city == 3 | bd_data_utm$pq_city == 4, ]

# 1, Peshawar | 2, Abbottabad 
pk_pesha_data <- pk_data_utm[pk_data_utm$pq_city == 1, ]
pk_abbot_data <- pk_data_utm[pk_data_utm$pq_city == 2, ]

```

```{r extract_coods, include=FALSE}
# Extract planar coordinates (in meters) 
bd_dhaka_coords <- sf::st_coordinates(bd_dhaka_data)
bd_narsi_coords <- sf::st_coordinates(bd_narsi_data)

pk_pesha_coords <- sf::st_coordinates(pk_pesha_data)
pk_abbot_coords <- sf::st_coordinates(pk_abbot_data)

# Check missing/invalid geometries
bd_dhaka_valid_idx <- stats::complete.cases(bd_dhaka_coords[, 1], bd_dhaka_coords[, 2]) & !is.na(sf::st_is_valid(bd_dhaka_data))
bd_dhaka_coords_valid <- bd_dhaka_coords[bd_dhaka_valid_idx, , drop = FALSE]
bd_narsi_valid_idx <- stats::complete.cases(bd_narsi_coords[, 1], bd_narsi_coords[, 2]) & !is.na(sf::st_is_valid(bd_narsi_data))
bd_narsi_coords_valid <- bd_narsi_coords[bd_narsi_valid_idx, , drop = FALSE]

pk_pesha_valid_idx <- stats::complete.cases(pk_pesha_coords[, 1], pk_pesha_coords[, 2]) & !is.na(sf::st_is_valid(pk_pesha_data))
pk_pesha_coords_valid <- pk_pesha_coords[pk_pesha_valid_idx, , drop = FALSE]
pk_abbot_valid_idx <- stats::complete.cases(pk_abbot_coords[, 1], pk_abbot_coords[, 2]) & !is.na(sf::st_is_valid(pk_abbot_data))
pk_abbot_coords_valid <- pk_abbot_coords[pk_abbot_valid_idx, , drop = FALSE]
```




```{r estimate_kmeans, include=FALSE}

# Run k-means to create 11 clusters
set.seed(42)  # for reproducibility
k <- 11


bd_dhaka_km <- kmeans(bd_dhaka_coords_valid, centers = k, nstart = 25, iter.max = 100)
bd_narsi_km <- kmeans(bd_narsi_coords_valid, centers = k, nstart = 25, iter.max = 100)
pk_pesha_km <- kmeans(pk_pesha_coords_valid, centers = k, nstart = 25, iter.max = 100)
pk_abbot_km <- kmeans(pk_abbot_coords_valid, centers = k, nstart = 25, iter.max = 100)


```


```{r asign_cluster_labels, include=FALSE}

# Map cluster labels back (keeping original row order)
bd_dhaka_cluster_col <- rep(NA_integer_, nrow(bd_dhaka_data))
bd_dhaka_cluster_col[bd_dhaka_valid_idx] <- bd_dhaka_km$cluster

bd_narsi_cluster_col <- rep(NA_integer_, nrow(bd_narsi_data))
bd_narsi_cluster_col[bd_narsi_valid_idx] <- bd_narsi_km$cluster

pk_pesha_cluster_col <- rep(NA_integer_, nrow(pk_pesha_data))
pk_pesha_cluster_col[pk_pesha_valid_idx] <- pk_pesha_km$cluster

pk_abbot_cluster_col <- rep(NA_integer_, nrow(pk_abbot_data))
pk_abbot_cluster_col[pk_abbot_valid_idx] <- pk_abbot_km$cluster

# Append as a new column, return to original CRS (optional)
bd_dhaka_clustered <- bd_dhaka_data |>
  dplyr::mutate(cluster_id =bd_dhaka_cluster_col) |>
  sf::st_transform(sf::st_crs(bd_data_geo))  

bd_narsi_clustered <- bd_narsi_data |>
  dplyr::mutate(cluster_id =bd_narsi_cluster_col) |>
  sf::st_transform(sf::st_crs(bd_data_geo))  

pk_pesha_clustered <- pk_pesha_data |>
  dplyr::mutate(cluster_id = pk_pesha_cluster_col) |>
  sf::st_transform(sf::st_crs(pk_data_geo)) 

pk_abbot_clustered <- pk_abbot_data |>
  dplyr::mutate(cluster_id = pk_abbot_cluster_col) |>
  sf::st_transform(sf::st_crs(pk_data_geo))

```


```{r save_clustered_pharmacies_layer, include=FALSE}
sf::st_write(bd_dhaka_clustered, dsn = "./clustered-pharmacies/bd_dhaka_clustered.geojson", layer = "bd_dhaka_clustered.geojson", append = FALSE, delete_dsn = TRUE)
sf::st_write(bd_narsi_clustered, dsn = "./clustered-pharmacies/bd_narsi_clustered.geojson", layer = "bd_narsi_clustered.geojson", append = FALSE, delete_dsn = TRUE)

sf::st_write(pk_pesha_clustered, dsn = "./clustered-pharmacies/pk_pesha_clustered.geojson", layer = "pk_pesha_clustered.geojson", append = FALSE, delete_dsn = TRUE)
sf::st_write(pk_abbot_clustered, dsn = "./clustered-pharmacies/pk_abbot_clustered.geojson", layer = "pk_abbot_clustered.geojson", append = FALSE, delete_dsn = TRUE)
```

```{r function_convex_hull, include=FALSE}

build_convex_hulls <- function(gdf, group_col, value_cols = NULL) {
  
  hull_sf <- gdf |>
    group_by(across(all_of(group_col))) |>
    summarise(
      point_count = n(),
      across(all_of(value_cols), list(
        sum  = ~ sum(.x,  na.rm = TRUE),
        count = ~ sum(!is.na(.x)),
        mean = ~ max(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
      )),
      geometry = st_convex_hull(st_combine(geometry)),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    st_as_sf()
  
  return(hull_sf)
}

```


```{r estimate_distance_between_clusters, include=FALSE}

add_nearest_distance <- function(hull_sf, group_col) {
  # to estimate distances in metres, a project CRC is needed
  hull_sf <- sf::st_transform(hull_sf, 32642)
  
  # Compute full distance matrix (polygon boundary to boundary)
  dist_matrix <- st_distance(hull_sf)
  diag(dist_matrix) <- NA  # ignore self-distance
  
  hull_sf <- hull_sf |>
    mutate(
      nearest_idx      = apply(dist_matrix, 1, which.min),
      nearest_group    = hull_sf[[group_col]][nearest_idx],
      nearest_distance = apply(dist_matrix, 1, min, na.rm = TRUE)
    ) |>
    select(-nearest_idx)
  
  # the final dataset is converted into WGS 84 CRS for compatibility
  hull_sf <- sf::st_transform(hull_sf, 4326)
  
  return(hull_sf)
}
```

```{r generate_convex_hull, include=FALSE}

cols = c("count_female", "count_male", "pq_c_daily_cus")   # ← replace with your actual column name(s)

bd_dhaka_hull <- build_convex_hulls(
  bd_dhaka_clustered,
  group_col  = "cluster_id",
  value_cols = cols
)
bd_dhaka_hull <- add_nearest_distance(bd_dhaka_hull, group_col = "cluster_id")

bd_narsi_hull <- build_convex_hulls(
  bd_narsi_clustered,
  group_col  = "cluster_id",
  value_cols = cols
)
bd_narsi_hull <- add_nearest_distance(bd_narsi_hull, group_col = "cluster_id")

pk_pesha_hull <- build_convex_hulls(
  pk_pesha_clustered,
  group_col  = "cluster_id",
  value_cols = cols
)
pk_pesha_hull <- add_nearest_distance(pk_pesha_hull, group_col = "cluster_id")

pk_abbot_hull <- build_convex_hulls(
  pk_abbot_clustered,
  group_col  = "cluster_id",
  value_cols = cols
)
pk_abbot_hull <- add_nearest_distance(pk_abbot_hull, group_col = "cluster_id")


```
